blocks.text: SINGAPORE — Malacañang on Tuesday maintained that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s five-day working visit to Singapore is aimed at boosting investments amid criticism over his anticipated attendance at the Formula 1 Singapore Grand Prix 2026.
